messages:
jia: idea: show estimated cost bands instead of a single flat number in Console. cache behavior changes across tenants so a band explains uncertainty better.
omar: agree. band = [p10, p50, p90] estimates. where do we compute it? Console backend batch vs inference API realtime?
lucy: we could compute a small sketch on the hot path that returns bands based on model-level hit-rate histograms (no tenant data) and per-request token guesses. cheap math.
kevin: careful about latency. make it opt-in header `x-rw-cost-bands` so SDKs/console can request it. if present, runtime must add <2ms p50.
maria: billing legal question: customers may use bands to estimate invoices. we need strict language in UI copy and link to billing docs + a confidence score.
tina: UX: show a narrow colored band on the sparkline and a tooltip: "estimated token units (p10/p50/p90). includes cache-savings toggle". also add a small "how we estimate" modal.
costbot: NOTE: prototype metrics available at eng-ml/cost-bands branch.
lucy: sample proto (opt-in response field):
```json
{"cost_bands_v1": {
  "p10_token_units": 0.0098,
  "p50_token_units": 0.0137,
  "p90_token_units": 0.0192,
  "cache_savings_p50": 0.0031,
  "confidence": "0.78",
  "note": "estimates based on model-level histograms; not invoice exact"
}}
```
omar: next steps: lucy to run latency + error distribution, kevin to draft API header & schema, tina to mock UX. canary plan: 5% traffic, compare band medians to billed units over 24h. any blockers?
jia: none from my side. thanks all.
